units: <cite ref="Nedarim 69a:6">Ned. 69ᵃ</cite> <he>ה׳ ראשונה</he> the first confirmation (when he said the first <he>קיים ליכי</he>).
<cite ref="Nedarim 69a:6">Ib.</cite> <he>ולא תיחול ה׳</he> but my confirmation shall not take effect; a. e.

<cite ref="Rosh Hashanah 2b:10">R. Hash. 2ᵇ</cite> <he>להֲקָמַת המשכן</he> dating from the erection of the Tabernacle. Y. Yoma I, 38ᶜ top; <cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 12:1">Num. R. s. 12</cite>, a. e. <he>ה׳ הלילה</he> the putting up (of the Tabernacle) by night; a. e.—Pl. <he>הֲקָמוֹת</he>.
<cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 12:1">Ib.</cite> <he>הֲקָמוֹתָיו</he> his repeated acts of putting up.
